extracted.name: Homemade Pie Crust
extracted.description: If you need a quick & easy homemade pie crust recipe, here it is!
instruction_lines: Mix all dry ingredients- flour, sugar, salt.
Add diced butter and cold water into dry ingredients.
Mix everything until all ingredients mesh into a smooth dough, don’t mesh too much. Place into bag and let rest for an 1 hour or max 3 days.
